item.title: So, We Moved In
item.description: Huzzah the last(?) post! After years of building, many Bunnings trips and an unreasonable amount of sanding, we finally moved into the Miette in February. It is now October. So, what have we been doing for the last eight months? Well, apparently the building never really stops. First two minute noodles in the tiny house Close up of our noodles, feels like every new place needs a memorable first meal
